scopeLabel: All seven main and ten supporting-information pages read as text and actual page images. bindings.caption: Load diluted nanocrystals in a quartz cuvette. Diluted hexane solution; concentration and volume unreported. No interpretation of the stated dimensions as a filled volume. Source reports 1 × 1 cm² quartz cuvette; liquid volume/height unreported.

bindings.caption: Excite with OPO pulses or the residual 1064 nm pump. Ekspla NT342/C/3/UVE OPO, frequency-tripled Q-switched Nd:YAG pump as described by SI; residual pump is a separate excitation option. Source lens and orthogonal collection arrangement; schematic separations/beam size not to scale.

bindings.caption: Collect and spectrally filter emission orthogonally. Acton SpectraPro2150i monochromator; Hamamatsu R10699 PMT; LeCroy Wavesurfer62Xs oscilloscope. PE9-C Ophir pyroelectric sensor measures pulse energy; DCU223M Thorlabs CCD estimates beam area. Generic conceptual vessel; source does not specify vessel dimensions, neck count, liquid level or apparatus geometry.

bindings.caption: Use NIR-excitation cleanup filters. 653 nm long-pass dielectric filter and RG615 color glass clean up the OPO NIR excitation. RG615 identity is not silently converted into an independently reported numerical cutoff. Generic conceptual vessel; source does not specify vessel dimensions, neck count, liquid level or apparatus geometry.

Use the 480 nm excitation emission filter. 538 nm long-pass emission filter before monochromator collection for the 480 nm excitation branch. Generic conceptual vessel; source does not specify vessel dimensions, neck count, liquid level or apparatus geometry.

Subtract dark noise, integrate transients and correct response. Integrate transient PMT counts within peak boundaries; correct PMT and 790 nm filter response. Fit a biexponential convolved with the measured 8 ns response for lifetime extraction. general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
